:::{#hero-heading}

<p style='text-align: justify;'>
I am an Economist at the [Chief Economist Team](https://competition-policy.ec.europa.eu/about-us/chief-economist_en) of [DG COMP](https://commission.europa.eu/about/departments-and-executive-agencies/competition_en), European Commission. I hold a PhD in Economics from the [Rome Economics Doctorate (RED)](https://www.redphd.it/), a program jointly run by [EIEF](https://www.eief.it/eief/), [LUISS](https://www.luiss.it/), [Sapienza University of Rome](https://economia.web.uniroma1.it/en) and [Tor Vergata University of Rome](https://web.uniroma2.it/).
</p>

<p style='text-align: justify;'>
I work across competition instruments, with a focus on digital markets and energy.
</p>

<p style='text-align: justify;'>
My PhD supervisors were [Matteo Paradisi](https://www.matteoparadisi.com/) and [Emilio Calvano](https://emiliocalvano.wixsite.com/emiliocalvano). 
</p>

:::
